ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixel values (black) covering approximately 90-95% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity (white) clusters making up the remaining 5-10% focused on distal edges and surface scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark pigmentation across the entire fluke surface. Distinct high-contrast white focal clusters are localized at the distal tips of both lobes. Scattered white punctate markings are mapped across the medial and lateral regions of the right lobe, and the lower-medial section of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated interior V-shaped notch angle of approximately 75 degrees. Bounding-box depth of the central depression is approximately 15% of the total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serrated boundary across both lobes. Peak-to-valley pixel amplitude ranges from 5 to 15 pixels. Deepest edge variations are localized on the outer third of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward curves for both lobes, tapering into acute, slightly recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 25 circular white pixel clusters (rosettes) predominantly located on the right lobe distal section and scattered across the left lobe medial surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned linear white pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying lengths (10-70 pixels), primarily concentrated on the left lobe with a vertical-diagonal orientation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive accumulation of linear rake marks and circular barnacle scars across the entire visible surface; no visible tissue loss or major traumatic amputations along the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical edge profile featuring significantly higher serration frequency and depth on the left lobe trailing edge relative to the right.
